name: arc-control
description: The trust and control layer between enterprise AI agents and the systems they act upon.

scripts.clean: tsc -b tsconfig.build.json --clean && rm -rf packages/*/dist connectors/*/dist apps/*/dist
scripts.harness: npm run build && node tools/harness/check-harness.mjs && node tools/harness/validate-client.mjs && node tools/harness/findings.mjs && node tools/harness/lint-release-notes.mjs && node tools/policy-packs/validate.mjs && node --test "tools/harness/*.test.mjs" "tools/policy-packs/*.test.mjs"
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test --silent && npm run evals --silent && node .github/scripts/check-dependencies.mjs && node .github/scripts/check-infrastructure.mjs && node examples/console-walkthrough/run.js > /dev/null
scripts.examples: npm run build && node examples/approval-required-agent/run.js && node examples/protected-mcp-server/run.js && node examples/console-walkthrough/run.js
